resources.string: Enter the address of your Nextcloud. Kombu opens its login page in your browser.
Sign in on the Nextcloud page in your browser and allow access for Kombu. Kombu continues automatically.
No app was found that can open the login page. Install or enable a web browser.
You are signed out. Kombu could not reach the server, so its app password is still listed in the security settings of your Nextcloud. You can remove it there.
Enter the address of your Nextcloud.
Kombu only connects over HTTPS. Use an address that starts with https://.
This is not a valid web address.
The server cannot be reached. Check the address and your internet connection.
This device does not trust the certificate of the server, so Kombu does not connect.
No Nextcloud was found at this address.
The server is in maintenance mode. Please try again later.
The login timed out. Please start again.
The login failed. Please try again.
Kombu needs the Cookbook app in Nextcloud. Ask the administrator of your Nextcloud to install and enable it.
Kombu needs Cookbook %2$s or newer, but this Nextcloud has Cookbook %1$s. Ask the administrator of your Nextcloud to update it.
You signed in with a different account. To use another account, sign out first; Kombu then deletes the recipes of the current account from this device.
The recipe no longer exists on the server.
Another recipe on the server already has this name.
Kombu deletes the stored login and the recipe copy on this device and removes its app password from your Nextcloud. Your recipes stay in your Nextcloud.

resources.string: The last sync failed: the server cannot be reached. Kombu tries again later.
The last sync failed: the server reported an error (HTTP %1$d). Kombu tries again later.
Your Nextcloud no longer accepts Kombu\'s app password. Sign in again to keep syncing. Your recipes and changes stay on this device.
The last sync failed: the Cookbook app is not available for your account.
Kombu needs Cookbook %2$s or newer to sync, but your Nextcloud has Cookbook %1$s.
